paragraphs: Work has started on a very big new project in Dublin. It will carry dirty water away from homes. The project is called Greater Dublin Drainage.
The Taoiseach, Micheál Martin, started the work on Monday. He dug the first piece of ground at Clonshaugh in north Dublin. A new treatment plant will be built there.
The project will cost up to €2.3 billion. It should be finished by the end of 2031. It will help up to 185,000 new homes in north Dublin, Meath and Kildare.
Dublin has only one big plant for dirty water now. It is at Ringsend. But the city is growing fast, and the old plant is nearly full.
The plan was first made about 20 years ago. Some people went to court to stop it. Martin said Ireland must build things like this faster.
sentZh: 都柏林一項非常大型的新工程已經開工。
它會把髒水從住家帶走。
這項工程叫做「大都柏林排水工程」。
總理米豪·馬丁在星期一啟動了這項工程。
他在都柏林北部的克朗肖挖下第一鏟土。
那裡將興建一座新的污水處理廠。
這項工程最多將花費23億歐元。
預計在2031年底前完工。
它將幫助都柏林北部、米斯郡和基爾代爾郡多達18.5萬戶新住宅。
都柏林現在只有一座大型污水處理廠。
它位於林森德。
但城市成長得很快，舊的處理廠幾乎已經滿載。
這個計畫大約在20年前首次提出。
有些人曾上法院想阻止它。
馬丁說，愛爾蘭必須更快地興建這類設施。

paragraphs: Work has begun on a huge new drainage project in Dublin. The Greater Dublin Drainage project will cost between €1.9 billion and €2.3 billion. It will take wastewater away from up to 185,000 new homes in north Dublin, south Meath and east Kildare.

On Monday, the Taoiseach, Micheál Martin, turned the first sod at a 30-hectare site in Clonshaugh, north Dublin. A large new wastewater treatment plant will be built there. The work should be finished by the end of 2031.

The project has several parts. There will be a 14km pipe under the ground from Blanchardstown to Clonshaugh and a pumping station at Abbotstown. Another pipe will go 11km out into the sea. There will also be a centre for treating sludge at Kilshane.

Martin said most people will never see the project, but it is very important for new housing. The population of the Dublin area has doubled in 50 years to about two million. He said Ireland has not built this kind of infrastructure quickly enough. He also said the planning and legal systems are too complicated.
The idea was first studied in 2005. During planning, some people objected and took cases to the High Court. A new law this year helped to speed things up.

Niall Gleeson, the head of Uisce Éireann, said the Ringsend plant was made bigger, but the growing city has already used much of that new space. North Dublin cannot keep sending its wastewater south, he said. He promised to keep disruption for local people as low as possible.
sentZh: 都柏林一項大型的新排水工程已經開工。
大都柏林排水工程將花費19億至23億歐元。
它將為都柏林北部、米斯郡南部和基爾代爾郡東部多達18.5萬戶新住宅排走污水。
星期一，總理米豪·馬丁在都柏林北部克朗肖一塊30公頃的用地上挖下第一鏟土。
那裡將興建一座大型的新污水處理廠。
工程預計在2031年底前完成。
這項工程包含幾個部分。
將有一條從布蘭查斯敦到克朗肖、長14公里的地下管道，以及位於阿博茨敦的一座抽水站。
另一條管道會向海中延伸11公里。
基爾香還會設立一個處理污泥的中心。
馬丁說，大多數人永遠不會看到這項工程，但它對新住宅非常重要。
都柏林地區的人口在50年間增加了一倍，達到約200萬。
他說，愛爾蘭興建這類基礎設施的速度不夠快。
他也說，規劃和法律制度太過複雜。
這個構想最早在2005年開始研究。
在規劃期間，有些人提出反對並向高等法院提起訴訟。
今年的一項新法律幫助加快了進度。
愛爾蘭水務公司負責人尼爾·格里森說，林森德處理廠已經擴建，但成長中的城市已用掉大部分新增的容量。
他說，都柏林北部不能一直把污水送往南部。
他承諾會盡量減少對當地居民的干擾。

paragraphs: Construction has officially started on the Greater Dublin Drainage project, a major wastewater scheme expected to cost up to €2.3 billion. Once complete, it will provide wastewater services for up to 185,000 new homes across north Dublin, south Meath and east Kildare, supporting a population of around 500,000.

Taoiseach Micheál Martin turned the sod on Monday at a 30-hectare site in Clonshaugh, where a new regional treatment plant will be built. Uisce Éireann, the national water utility, has given a provisional budget of €1.9 billion to €2.3 billion, with the main works due to finish in 2031.

The scheme includes a 14km orbital sewer running from Blanchardstown to Clonshaugh, a pumping station at Abbotstown and an 11km marine outfall that will release treated water about 6km offshore. A facility for processing sludge will also be built at Kilshane.

Speaking at the launch, Martin said the project would be largely invisible but was fundamental to economic growth and housing. He pointed out that the population of the Greater Dublin Area has doubled over 50 years to roughly two million. He admitted that the State had failed to deliver infrastructure at the scale and speed required, describing the planning and legal systems as extremely complex.

Studies for the project began in 2005, and it faced objections and High Court challenges during the planning process. Minister for Public Expenditure Jack Chambers said new critical infrastructure legislation had allowed one key approval to be granted in just 75 days, around five times faster than similar past applications.

Uisce Éireann chief executive Niall Gleeson said €600 million had been invested to expand the Ringsend plant, but population growth had absorbed much of the extra capacity. He acknowledged local concerns about construction and pledged to minimise disruption.
sentZh: 大都柏林排水工程正式動工，這項大型污水計畫預計花費最多23億歐元。
完工後，它將為都柏林北部、米斯郡南部和基爾代爾郡東部多達18.5萬戶新住宅提供污水服務，支撐約50萬人口。
總理米豪·馬丁星期一在克朗肖一塊30公頃的用地上主持動土，那裡將興建一座新的區域污水處理廠。
國家水務公司愛爾蘭水務提出19億至23億歐元的暫定預算，主要工程預計於2031年完成。
這項計畫包括一條從布蘭查斯敦通往克朗肖、長14公里的環狀下水道，阿博茨敦的一座抽水站，以及一條11公里長、將處理後的水排放到離岸約6公里處的海洋排放管。
基爾香也將興建一座污泥處理設施。
馬丁在啟動儀式上說，這項工程大部分是看不見的，但對經濟成長和住宅至關重要。
他指出，大都柏林地區的人口在50年間翻倍，達到約200萬。
他承認國家未能以所需的規模和速度提供基礎設施，並形容規劃和法律制度極為複雜。
這項工程的研究始於2005年，在規劃過程中曾遭遇反對及高等法院的訴訟挑戰。
公共支出部長傑克·錢伯斯說，新的關鍵基礎設施法案讓一項重要核准僅用75天就獲批，比過去類似申請快約五倍。
愛爾蘭水務執行長尼爾·格里森說，已投入6億歐元擴建林森德處理廠，但人口成長已吸收了大部分新增容量。
他承認當地居民對施工的擔憂，並承諾將干擾降到最低。

paragraphs: Ground has finally been broken on the Greater Dublin Drainage project, a long-delayed wastewater scheme with a price tag of up to €2.3 billion. When finished, it will unlock wastewater capacity for as many as 185,000 new homes in north Dublin, south Meath and east Kildare, catering for some 500,000 residents.

Taoiseach Micheál Martin performed the sod-turning ceremony on Monday at a 30-hectare site in Clonshaugh, earmarked for a new regional treatment plant. Uisce Éireann has put forward a provisional budget of between €1.9 billion and €2.3 billion, with the bulk of the works slated for completion in 2031, more than two decades after the scheme was first mooted.

The undertaking comprises a 14km orbital sewer stretching from Blanchardstown to Clonshaugh, a pumping station at Abbotstown and an 11km marine outfall discharging treated effluent roughly 6km out to sea, alongside a sludge-processing hub at Kilshane.

Martin conceded that the scheme would be largely invisible to the public, yet insisted it was indispensable to growth and housing in a region whose population has doubled in half a century to around two million. In a frank admission, he acknowledged that the State had fallen short in delivering infrastructure at the requisite scale and pace, branding the planning and legal systems cumbersome and convoluted.

Studies date back to 2005, and the project was dogged by objections and High Court challenges. Jack Chambers, the Minister for Public Expenditure, noted that recently enacted critical infrastructure legislation had enabled a key consent to be secured in a mere 75 days, roughly five times faster than comparable applications.

Niall Gleeson, chief executive of Uisce Éireann, remarked that a €600 million upgrade at Ringsend had boosted capacity by half, only for relentless growth to swallow much of the gain. Conceding that residents had misgivings, he vowed to keep disruption to a minimum.
sentZh: 延宕已久、造價最高達23億歐元的大都柏林排水工程終於動土。
完工後，它將為都柏林北部、米斯郡南部和基爾代爾郡東部多達18.5萬戶新住宅釋出污水處理容量，滿足約50萬居民的需求。
總理米豪·馬丁星期一在克朗肖一塊30公頃的用地上主持動土儀式，該地已指定用來興建新的區域處理廠。
愛爾蘭水務提出19億至23億歐元的暫定預算，大部分工程預定於2031年完成，距離計畫首次被提出已超過二十年。
這項工程包括一條從布蘭查斯敦延伸到克朗肖的14公里環狀下水道、阿博茨敦的抽水站、一條把處理後的污水排放到外海約6公里處的11公里海洋排放管，以及基爾香的污泥處理中心。
馬丁承認這項計畫大部分不會被民眾看見，但堅稱它對一個人口在半世紀內翻倍至約200萬的地區的成長與住宅而言不可或缺。
他坦白承認，國家在以必要的規模和速度提供基礎設施方面有所不足，並批評規劃和法律制度繁瑣又複雜。
相關研究可追溯至2005年，這項工程一直受到反對聲浪和高等法院訴訟的困擾。
公共支出部長傑克·錢伯斯指出，最近通過的關鍵基礎設施法案讓一項重要許可僅用75天就取得，比同類申請快約五倍。
愛爾蘭水務執行長尼爾·格里森表示，林森德6億歐元的升級工程使容量提高了一半，但持續不斷的成長卻吞掉了大部分增量。
他承認居民有所疑慮，並誓言將干擾減到最少。

paragraphs: Construction has commenced on the Greater Dublin Drainage project, a substantial wastewater infrastructure scheme with an estimated cost of up to €2.3 billion. Upon completion, it is projected to provide wastewater capacity for up to 185,000 new dwellings across north Dublin, south Meath and east Kildare, thereby accommodating a population of approximately 500,000.

The Taoiseach, Micheál Martin, formally inaugurated the works on Monday at a 30-hectare site in Clonshaugh, where a regional treatment facility will be constructed. Uisce Éireann has indicated a provisional budget ranging from €1.9 billion to €2.3 billion, with the principal works scheduled for completion in 2031.

The scheme consists of several interrelated components: a 14km orbital sewer between Blanchardstown and Clonshaugh, a pumping station at Abbotstown, an 11km marine outfall extending approximately 6km offshore, and a sludge-processing facility at Kilshane.

Martin characterised the project as largely invisible yet fundamental to economic expansion and housing provision, particularly given that the population of the Greater Dublin Area has doubled over five decades to approximately two million. Nevertheless, he acknowledged that the State had not delivered infrastructure at the necessary scale or speed, attributing this in part to planning and legal frameworks that he described as exceedingly complex.

Preliminary studies were initiated in 2005, and the proposal subsequently encountered considerable opposition, including High Court challenges. According to Jack Chambers, the Minister for Public Expenditure, newly introduced critical infrastructure legislation enabled a crucial consent to be obtained within 75 days, approximately five times faster than in comparable previous cases.

Niall Gleeson, chief executive of Uisce Éireann, observed that although a €600 million investment had increased the capacity of the Ringsend plant by 50 per cent, sustained population growth had absorbed much of this additional capacity. He recognised residents' concerns and committed to minimising local disruption.

完工後，預計將為都柏林北部、米斯郡南部和基爾代爾郡東部多達18.5萬戶新住宅提供污水處理容量，從而容納約50萬人口。
總理米豪·馬丁星期一在克朗肖一塊30公頃的用地上正式為工程揭幕，那裡將興建一座區域處理設施。
愛爾蘭水務表示暫定預算介於19億至23億歐元之間，主要工程預定於2031年完成。
這項計畫由幾個相互關聯的部分組成：布蘭查斯敦與克朗肖之間的14公里環狀下水道、阿博茨敦的抽水站、延伸至離岸約6公里的11公里海洋排放管，以及基爾香的污泥處理設施。
馬丁形容這項工程大部分看不見，卻對經濟擴張和住宅供應至關重要，尤其是大都柏林地區的人口在五十年間已翻倍至約200萬。
然而，他承認國家未能以必要的規模或速度提供基礎設施，並將部分原因歸咎於他所形容極其複雜的規劃與法律框架。
初步研究於2005年展開，該提案隨後遭遇相當大的反對，包括高等法院的訴訟挑戰。
據公共支出部長傑克·錢伯斯表示，新推出的關鍵基礎設施法案讓一項重要許可在75天內取得，比以往同類案件快約五倍。
愛爾蘭水務執行長尼爾·格里森指出，雖然6億歐元的投資使林森德處理廠的容量增加了50%，但持續的人口成長吸收了大部分新增容量。
他認同居民的擔憂，並承諾將對當地的干擾降至最低。
